title: tenumerate crashes when given a start value
prompt:
`tqdm.contrib.tenumerate(iterable, start)` must behave like `enumerate(iterable, start)` with a progress bar. With a start value, `list(tenumerate(a, 42))` raises `TypeError` instead of numbering from 42; it must equal `list(enumerate(a, 42))`.

Tests: `python -m pytest -q tqdm/tests/tests_tqdm.py` runs the main test file. pytest collects only files named test_*.py, so name each tqdm/tests/tests_*.py file you want to run.

hiddenChecks.command: node .bench-hidden/place.js && python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tqdm/tests/tests_contrib.py tqdm/tests/tests_tqdm.py --deselect tqdm/tests/tests_contrib.py::test_enumerate
